identification: Trunk of about five antique dolls: three German-type bisque socket-head sleep-eye dolls (Armand Marseille / Schoenau Hoffmeister type, c.1900-1920), one black-haired glazed china shoulder-head in lace dress, one more in white bonnet. No marks seen, maker unconfirmed.

entries.note: Single Armand Marseille doll with crying noise c1920. Local database record only, not opened. Over 10 years old. One doll, not a group.

viewing_check: Check the back of each bisque head and shoulder plate for marks (AM, Armand Marseille, S&H, Simon Halbig, mould number); look under wigs for hairline cracks, chips, and for repairs or replaced limbs; check bodies (composition or kid) and that heads are original to bodies; check china head for cracks.
